subject: Eligibility check: Venture Studio credit bundle for BlueHarbor cohort
messages:

To: Markus Klein <markus@redwood.inference>
Cc: Rajiv Singh <rajiv@incubate.co>
Date: Wed, 1 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Venture Studio credit allocation for BlueHarbor April cohort

Hi Markus —

Thanks again for the quick demo last week. BlueHarbor is finalizing the list for our April venture studio cohort (start date: 2026-04-10) and we'd love to confirm eligibility for the startup credit bundle we discussed: 60k tokens per company for 8 companies (provisional), plus an optional trial extension for cohort leads.

Attached is the roster and a one-pager on the studio structure. Two quick asks we hope you can help with:
- Eligibility verification for the 8 startups (we can provide any corporate docs).
- If verified, can you issue a single promo code for the cohort (self-serve redemption) and confirm expiry/extension options?

Let me know if you need KYC/POC contact details or an LOI — happy to sign a standard accelerator agreement if that helps speed things up.

Appreciate it —
Emma Liu
Partnerships Manager, BlueHarbor Ventures

Date: Wed, 1 Apr 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Venture Studio credit allocation for BlueHarbor April cohort

Hi Emma —

Thanks — this looks like a great fit. Quick note on process so expectations are clear:

1) Verification: we run a lightweight eligibility check (domain + entity match + basic portfolio screen).
2) Issuance: once verified, our self-serve portal can create a single redeemable promo code scoped to the cohort (you can distribute it).
3) Billing cap: Finance needs to approve a promotional cap for the account before we make the code live.

Monica — could you please run the eligibility checks on the attached roster and flag any names/domains that need manual review?
Naomi — can you confirm a promo cap for BlueHarbor (expected maximum usage: ~480k tokens total for the initial issuance)? If you prefer, we can issue a provisional partial code and top up after the agreement is signed.

If it helps, I can pre-populate the self-serve issuance form and trigger it as soon as we get your OK.

Thanks,
Markus Klein
Head of Partnerships — Redwood Inference

Date: Thu, 2 Apr 2026 08:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Venture Studio credit allocation for BlueHarbor April cohort

Markus / Emma —

Ran the roster through our eligibility checks this morning. Summary:
- 6/8 companies have clean domain/entity matches and no sanctions/blocklist hits.
- 1 company (PivotLabs) uses a recently-registered domain (pivot-labs.io) — flagged for manual domain ownership proof.
- 1 company (ChatKindred) shows a public security advisory from a third-party scanner; not fatal but needs remediation evidence before we give full credits.

Recommendation: issue a provisional cohort promo code for 6 companies now (60k tokens each = 360k tokens), hold the remaining 2 companies pending proof of domain ownership/remediation. We can convert the held allotment into additional promo codes once the docs arrive.

Attached: redflag_screenshot.png (example advisory). If BlueHarbor can get domain verification for PivotLabs and an acknowledgement/remediation plan from ChatKindred, we can clear them within 48 hours.

Monica
Partnerships Ops — Redwood Inference

Markus — please proceed with:

- Issue two provisional single-company codes (30k tokens each) for PivotLabs and ChatKindred, with expiry in 30 days.

I'll log the cap and approval in the deal record (HS-75291) so accounting has the visibility.

Naomi Feldman

Great — thanks for the quick turnaround, team. Next steps (I will action today):

   - Cohort code: REDEV-BH-APR26 (scoped to 6 company emails/domains, 60k tokens each).
   - Provisional codes: REDEV-BH-PIVOT (30k, 30d expiry), REDEV-BH-CHAT (30k, 30d expiry).

2) I have created a DocuSign for BlueHarbor to sign our standard accelerator MSA (link below). Please sign so we can remove the provisional holds.
